name: GoToWebPageNode
label: Go To Web Page
description: Navigates a web browser instance to a specified URL, back, forward, or reload.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WebBrowserInstance
fields.label: Web Browser Instance
fields.description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

fields.name: NavigateAction
fields.label: Navigate Action
fields.description: Specifies the type of navigation action to perform.

selectOptions.label: Back
selectOptions.description: Navigates back in the browser history.

selectOptions.label: Forward
selectOptions.description: Navigates forward in the browser history.

fields.name: Url
fields.label: URL
fields.description: The URL to navigate to when 'Navigate Action' is 'ToUrl'.

fields.name: WaitForPageToLoad
fields.label: Wait for Page to Load
fields.description: If true, waits for the page to fully load before continuing.

fields.name: TimeoutForPageLoad
fields.label: Timeout for Page Load
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the page to load.

fields.name: IfDialogAppears
fields.label: Handle Dialog
fields.description: Specifies what to do if a dialog appears after navigating.

selectOptions.label: Close It
selectOptions.description: Automatically close any pop-up dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Press a specified button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Close It / Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Close or press a button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Accept Alert
selectOptions.description: Accept the alert dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Dismiss Alert
selectOptions.description: Dismiss the alert dialog that appears.

fields.name: DialogButtonToPress
fields.label: Dialog Button to Press
fields.description: The name of the button to press if a dialog appears (e.g., 'Ok', 'Cancel').
